newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity offers life insurance direct to consumers.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity offers life insurance direct to consumers.

text.p: Fidelity Investments, a privately owned mutual fund company, said on Wednesday that it had begun offering term life insurance directly to consumers through its own insurance company, Fidelity Investments Life Insurance Co.

"We believe that selling term life insurance direct to the consumer will demystify term insurance and simplify the purchase process for consumers," said Farrell Dolan, vice president the life insurance company.
The new term insurance, currently available in 44 states, offers consumers a choice of five coverage periods, including one-, five-, 10-, 15- and 20-year term policies.
Coverage amounts start at $250,000 and a spouse may apply for an additional policy of $100,000 or more, Fidelity said.
